sentence: This project studies how catechol, a pollutant from burning wood, changes on mineral surfaces in air under sunlight.
This project builds a unified model that solves many visual correspondence problems to help a machine understand dynamic scenes.
This project builds magnetic nanoparticles coated with polymer brushes that release compounds using heat from alternating magnetic fields to control neural activity.
This project builds a programmable wireless architecture that lets researchers manage policies and uses formal verification to ensure compliance across institutions.
This project builds a national center for next generation manufacturing that shares educational materials.
This project builds a program that teaches quantum computing through an online certificate program and workshops.
This project tests whether microtubules send signals along their length by changing their structure inside cells.
This project studies how genetic changes in bioengineered soil microbes affect community assembly and ecosystem functioning.
This project builds video coding systems based on generative adversarial networks that give sharp decoded videos and use less power.
This project studies how surface patterns on biomaterials change the behavior of immune cells near bacteria.
This project studies waterfowl to find out how similar feeding traits evolved independently and whether they involve similar genetic changes.
This project builds a nanoparticle-based system that can isolate monoclonal antibodies directly from cell cultures.
This project builds a workflow that generates terrain parameters from digital elevation models at different resolutions and stores them in an open-access commons.
This project develops methods to test, tune and correct hardware errors in deep neural networks caused by manufacturing imperfections and noise.
This project studies how low dose x-rays affect cells, including damage to DNA and cell proliferation.
